title: A GUN ON THE BELT SHOWS ITS CARD
why: His order of 2026-10-12: guns on the tactical belt should show their gun card when the mouse is over them. Rest the mouse on a gun key (in a raid, on the Undercroft floor and in its backpack) and that gun stat card shows just above the key: the name with its forge MK, the element of a MK III in its colour, damage, rate, magazine, range and handling. The gun in your hands reads IN HANDS; the other gun you carry and a packed gun are compared with it, as on pickup. The card waits a short moment on one key, so sweeping the crosshair across the belt never flashes cards, and it goes the moment the mouse leaves. It takes no click: firing, aiming and dragging work as before, and it hides while you hold the trigger, drag, or have the map or the pause box open. It stays inside the screen at 1080p and 4K.
now: Rest the mouse on a gun on the tactical belt and its stat card shows above it.
